TXT_CODE_COMMON_ENTER_AN_INTEGER_PORT_NU: Enter an integer port number. Default: 23333.
TXT_CODE_COMMON_ENABLE_WHEN_USING_A_REVE: Enable when using a reverse proxy to read the client’s real IP.
TXT_CODE_COMMON_ENTER_ITS_IP_ADDRESS_TO_: Enter its IP address to bind to a specific network interface.
TXT_CODE_SERVER_CROSS_ORIGIN_SECURITY_HI: Allows cross-origin requests from any origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *). This may reduce security.
TXT_CODE_SERVER_PREFIX_TIP: Serve the panel under a sub-path, for example /panel. Leave it empty to serve from the root.
TXT_CODE_SERVER_RESTART_TIP: These settings are applied when the web server starts. Restart the panel for a change to take effect.
TXT_CODE_SERVER_SSL_KEY_TIP: Path to the private key file, absolute or relative to the panel directory.
TXT_CODE_SERVER_SSL_PEM_TIP: Path to the certificate file, absolute or relative to the panel directory.
TXT_CODE_SERVER_SSL_TIP: Serve the panel over HTTPS using the certificate below. Both files are required.
TXT_CODE_COMMON_NAME_OF_THE_REQUEST_HEAD: Name of the request header containing the client’s real IP.
